about_the_game:
Step into the decaying halls of an abandoned orphanage, where forgotten whispers and unseen horrors lurk in the shadows. The Girl in the Dark is a psychological horror experience that challenges your perception of reality. With minimal jump scares, the fear comes from the mind—twisting truths, unsettling discoveries, and a story filled with dark, unexpected turns.

𝙸𝚗𝚟𝚎𝚜𝚝𝚒𝚐𝚊𝚝𝚎

Are you ready to face your nerves and set out on your journey?

On your journey, your nerves will betray you, testing your every step with fear and uncertainty. Every creak, every shadow, every whisper will make you question your sanity as you dive deeper into the horrors that await.

𝘜𝘯𝘳𝘢𝘷𝘦𝘭 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘮𝘺𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘪𝘦𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘭𝘪𝘦

Can you handle the pressure? With everything around you crumbling and driving you to the edge of madness, will you be able to solve the riddles that stand between you and your survival?

𝙴𝚗𝚍𝚕𝚎𝚜𝚜 𝙳𝚎𝚜𝚌𝚎𝚗𝚝: 𝚃𝚑𝚎 𝙼𝚒𝚗𝚍’𝚜 𝙼𝚊𝚣𝚎

Endless thrills. Constant updates bringing more riddles, more psychological games. Are you ready for what’s to come?

content_descriptors.notes: Horror scenes with jumpscares. Textures with blood, loud sounds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i3-7100 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3200G or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Explore an abandoned orphanage where reality twists and the past haunts every step. With minimal jump scares but intense psychological horror, your mind becomes the real enemy.
